story.title: Sierra raises $950M as race to own enterprise AI customer experience heats up
story.summary: Sierra, an AI startup focused on enterprise customer experience, has raised $950 million, giving it over $1 billion in total capital. The company says it intends to use the funding to become the global standard for AI-powered customer interactions. The raise signals intense investor confidence in enterprise AI as a near-term revenue category, with major players competing for dominant market position.
